title: Mining the Design Space of Multi-Agent Workflows
title_zh: 挖掘多智能体工作流的设计空间

paragraphs.en: Designing large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems (MAS) still relies on trial and error and informal “folk wisdom.” Manual studies test only a few communication structures or topologies (e.g., sequential, parallel, shared-memory, or debate), while automated optimizers discard search trajectories after selecting a task-specific workflow. We present a two-phase pipeline for mining reproducible design principles from workflow code and execution traces. We repurpose AFlow’s MCTS optimizer across six composable operators and 26 deterministically verified Enigmata tasks, retaining all intermediate rounds to build a corpus of 28,568 executable workflows. A sandboxed AutoResearch loop then mines orchestration code and prompt templates under an L 0 L_{0} -penalized validation objective and tests candidate principles on held-out searches. Across 300 feature-mining trials, we identify effects that persist on held-out searches across three levels of workflow design: workflows beginning with independent solvers and one-shot aggregation ( Star -first) perform worse ( Δ = − 0.045 \Delta=-0.045 ); persistent shared documents ( SharedMemory ) outperform debate ( Δ = + 0.135 \Delta=+0.135 ); and prompt specificity and placeholder-based context routing yield gains comparable to communication-structure selection ( Δ = + 0.118 \Delta=+0.118 ). More broadly, our pipeline and results show the feasibility of turning discarded search trajectories into a statistical testbed for discovering and validating multi-agent workflow design principles.

paragraphs.en: Large Language Model (LLM)–based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have become a foundational tool for complex problem solving in many areas such as software engineering [ 29 ] , economic forecasting [ 9 , 6 ] , and scientific discovery [ 21 , 23 ] . In these systems, performance depends not only on the base LLM, but critically on the workflow architecture: how agents are connected, how intermediate state is routed, and how role-specific prompts are structured [ 19 ] . Yet, designing multi-agent workflows remains largely guided by manual trial-and-error and informal “folk wisdom” (e.g., “more agents improve accuracy” or “multi-agent debate improves reasoning”). This raises the question: Can workflow search traces be used to identify statistically reliable principles for multi-agent system design?
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）已成为许多领域（如软件工程 [ 29 ]、经济预测 [ 9 , 6 ] 和科学发现 [ 21 , 23 ]）中复杂问题求解的基础工具。 在这些系统中，性能不仅取决于基础大语言模型，更关键地取决于工作流架构：智能体之间如何连接、中间状态如何路由，以及角色专属提示词如何构建 [ 19 ]。 然而，多智能体工作流的设计在很大程度上仍依赖人工试错和非正式的“经验之谈”（例如“更多智能体能提高准确性”或“多智能体辩论能改善推理”）。 这就引出了一个问题：工作流搜索轨迹能否被用于识别多智能体系统设计在统计上可靠的原则？

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have taken initial steps toward quantifying MAS design choices, examining agent-count scaling [ 34 ] , load balancing in compressor-predictor pipelines [ 14 ] , and canonical topologies [ 19 ] . However, two bottlenecks limit existing paradigms: (1) manual empirical studies evaluate only a handful of fixed, hand-crafted topologies (typically 3–5 patterns), leaving composed workflows and sub-topological prompt implementations unexamined; and (2) automated workflow optimizers such as AFlow [ 33 ] and ADAS [ 15 ] dynamically search over code and prompts, but discard over 95 % 95\% of evaluated architectures to return a single task-specific optimum W ∗ W^{*} .
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究已在量化多智能体系统（MAS）设计选择方面迈出了初步步伐，考察了智能体数量扩展 [34]、压缩器-预测器流水线中的负载均衡 [14]，以及规范化拓扑 [19]。 然而，现有范式存在两个瓶颈：（1）人工实证研究仅评估少数固定的手工设计拓扑（通常为 3–5 种模式），未考察组合式工作流与子拓扑层面的提示实现；（2）诸如 AFlow [33] 和 ADAS [15] 之类的自动化工作流优化器虽然在代码和提示上动态搜索，但会丢弃超过 95% 95\% 的已评估架构，仅返回单一的任务特定最优解 W ∗ W^{*} 。

paragraphs.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce a two-phase empirical pipeline that transforms complete workflow-search trajectories into a controlled testbed for discovering design principles (Fig. 1 ). In the Sampling Phase , we repurpose the MCTS-based AFlow optimizer [ 33 ] to compose six workflow operators: Sequential , Star , SharedMemory , Debate , StarWithCoordinator , and DebateWithModerator . Rather than retaining only the final workflow, we collect all N = 20 N=20 evaluated workflows from each of K = 5 K=5 independent runs per condition. To limit confounding from external tools, specialized domain knowledge, and LLM-as-a-judge noise, we evaluate every workflow in a tool-free setting on 26 deterministically verified reasoning tasks from Enigmata [ 3 ] . This produces a corpus of 28,568 28{,}568 executable workflow–task–performance triplets.
paragraphs.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出一个两阶段的实证流程，将完整的工作流搜索轨迹转化为一个用于发现设计原则的受控测试平台（图 1）。 在采样阶段（Sampling Phase），我们改造基于 MCTS 的 AFlow 优化器 [33]，用于组合六种工作流算子：Sequential、Star、SharedMemory、Debate、StarWithCoordinator 和 DebateWithModerator。 我们不只保留最终的工作流，而是从每种条件下的 K=5 次独立运行中收集全部 N=20 个经过评估的工作流。 为了限制外部工具、专业领域知识和 LLM-as-a-judge 噪声带来的干扰，我们在无工具设置下，使用来自 Enigmata [3] 的 26 个可确定性验证的推理任务对每个工作流进行评估。 这最终产生了一个包含 28,568 个可执行的工作流–任务–性能三元组的数据集。

paragraphs.en: Designing effective multi-agent LLM workflows has largely relied on practitioner heuristics [ 27 , 5 ] . While classical AI established blackboard architectures [ 13 ] where specialist modules read and write to a shared global state, recent LLM-MAS studies have begun quantifying specific design dimensions: Zhang et al. [34] and Qian et al. [24] studied agent-count and collaboration scaling; He et al. [14] analyzed load balancing in compressor-predictor pipelines; Chen et al. [4] examined diversity collapse; Willis et al. [28] studied large agent swarms; and Kim et al. [19] benchmarked five canonical MAS patterns. However, these works evaluate a small, fixed set of hand-crafted topologies and treat prompts as fixed constants. By contrast, we mine empirical regularities across tens of thousands of dynamically composed workflows, jointly analyzing macroscopic topologies and sub-topological prompt structure.

paragraphs.en: Automated search methods have targeted prompt optimization [ 18 , 12 , 1 ] , graph connections [ 36 , 31 ] , and agent code evolution [ 32 ] . Full-workflow optimizers, including MCTS-based AFlow [ 33 ] , MASS [ 35 ] , ADAS [ 15 ] , and supernet routing [ 30 ] , iteratively mutate workflow graphs and prompts to maximize accuracy. Whereas these methods discard intermediate candidates to output a single workflow W ∗ W^{*} , we repurpose MCTS workflow search to harvest complete search trajectories for population-level analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化搜索方法已针对提示词优化 [ 18 , 12 , 1 ] 、图连接 [ 36 , 31 ] 以及智能体代码演化 [ 32 ] 展开。 全工作流优化器，包括基于 MCTS 的 AFlow [ 33 ] 、MASS [ 35 ] 、ADAS [ 15 ] 以及超网路由 [ 30 ] ，通过迭代变异工作流图和提示词来最大化准确率。 这些方法丢弃中间候选解以输出单一工作流 W ∗ W^{*} ，而我们则重新利用 MCTS 工作流搜索来收集完整的搜索轨迹，以进行种群层面的分析。

paragraphs.en: Downstream agentic benchmarks in software engineering [ 16 , 29 ] , API/web interaction [ 25 , 10 ] , and scientific research [ 2 ] conflate multi-agent coordination with domain knowledge, external tool reliability, and LLM-as-a-judge variance [ 19 ] . To isolate reasoning and coordination, synthetic benchmarks use verifiable problems in constraint satisfaction [ 20 ] , combinatorics [ 22 ] , and SAT [ 26 ] . We evaluate workflows on Enigmata [ 3 ] , leveraging its parametric generators and deterministic verifiers across difficulty tiers.

paragraphs.en: Given a collection of executable multi-agent workflows, each evaluated on a concrete reasoning task T T (e.g., a bundle of Sudoku instances checked by a verifier), we ask: what structural properties of the workflow designs and prompts reliably predict higher task performance? In this section, we introduce our workflow representations and mining objective (§ III-A ), as well as outline the three operational challenges motivating our pipeline in § III-B .

paragraphs.en: A workflow W = ( 𝒩 , C , Ω ) W=(\mathcal{N},C,\Omega) is operationalized as an executable Python program comprising two coupled source files: an orchestration graph ( graph.py ) and a prompt module ( prompt.py ). paragraphs.en: Mining principles requires a sample that both covers many distinct designs and consists of competent implementations. The naive route to coverage, generating workflow programs from scratch (e.g., prompting an LLM to write arbitrary orchestration code and prompts without constraints), fails the second requirement: most candidates break with syntax errors or degenerate prompts, burying topological effects under implementation noise. Conversely, keeping only an optimizer’s final argmax workflow W ∗ W^{*} discards the negative and intermediate examples needed to estimate contrasts. We therefore repurpose the MCTS-based AFlow optimizer (§ IV-A ) over a structured 6-operator vocabulary 𝒪 \mathcal{O} and retain all N = 20 N=20 intermediate workflows per search under a consistent LLM optimizer policy.

paragraphs.en: Our pipeline operates in two stages: a sampling phase that pairs full-trace AFlow workflow search (§ IV-A ) with deterministic Enigmata evaluation (§ IV-B ), followed by an analysis phase that mines workflow code and prompt features via a sandboxed AutoResearch loop (§ IV-C ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的流程分为两个阶段运行：第一阶段是采样阶段，将全轨迹的 AFlow 工作流搜索（§ IV-A）与确定性的 Enigmata 评估（§ IV-B）相结合；随后是分析阶段，通过沙盒化的 AutoResearch 循环挖掘工作流代码与提示词特征（§ IV-C）。

paragraphs.en: In AFlow [ 33 ] , each workflow W W is represented as an executable Python class in graph.py accompanied by role-specific hard text prompt templates in prompt.py (no soft prompts or gradient updates). Given a task bundle T T , AFlow searches over workflows across N = 20 N=20 MCTS rounds: (i) Selection: A parent workflow is sampled from the top- k k ( k = 4 k=4 ) evaluated workflows using a mixed uniform/softmax distribution ( λ = 0.2 \lambda=0.2 uniform weight, temperature α = 0.4 \alpha=0.4 ; Eq. 4 in § C-B ) to prevent premature collapse; (ii) Expansion: An LLM optimizer (fixed to GPT-5.4 at temperature 0 0 ) inspects the parent’s code and score history and proposes an edit that adds, removes, or rechains operators in graph.py and refines role prompts in prompt.py (§ D-D ); (iii) Evaluation: The child workflow is executed on the M = 20 M=20 instances in T T ; and (iv) Backpropagation: Scores and costs are recorded in the search tree. Steps (i)–(iv) are the unmodified AFlow loop; we change three things (§ C-C ). First, the operator registry is replaced by our six primitives (Fig. 2 ), so every proposed edit is a composition of known topologies. Second, evaluation targets fixed Enigmata bundles with deterministic verifiers (§ IV-B ). Third, unlike point optimization that returns only W ∗ W^{*} , we retain all N = 20 N=20 workflows per trace across K = 5 K=5 independent runs per condition, capturing both successful and failed designs below the best-so-far envelope (Fig. 5 ; single tree in Fig. 11 , § H ).

paragraphs.en: To span established coordination patterns while permitting multi-stage compositions, we equip the search space with six operator primitives 𝒪 \mathcal{O} (Fig. 2 , Table VIII ; § C-A ), synthesized from recent MAS surveys [ 19 , 35 , 30 , 5 ] : single-agent linear chaining ( Sequential ), isolated parallel fan-out followed by one-shot aggregation ( Star ), blackboard-style sequential writing to a persistent shared document ( SharedMemory ; 13 ), all-to-all peer proposal exchange ( Debate ), and hub-and-spoke or moderated multi-round variants ( StarWithCoordinator , DebateWithModerator ). An operation in graph.py is an asynchronous call to one operator primitive with optimizer-chosen parameters: n ∈ [ 1 , 10 ] n\in[1,10] workers, r ∈ [ 1 , 5 ] r\in[1,5] rounds , and custom prompts in prompt.py . A round is one complete pass of the operator’s communication pattern, e.g., every SharedMemory worker reads the document once and appends to it, or every Debate worker reads its peers’ proposals once and revises, and an operator with r > 1 r>1 repeats this pass r r times, each pass conditioned on the previous one (Fig. 2 is drawn for r = 2 r{=}2 ); these operator rounds are distinct from the N = 20 N{=}20 MCTS search rounds above. Operations can be chained sequentially or conditionally, with the outputs of one operator (and the original problem) forwarded into the prompts of the next (e.g., Star → Sequential \textsc{Star}\to\textsc{Sequential} in Fig. 3 ; the most common chains are listed in Table XII ). Each operator uses up to two LLM roles (a worker and an aggregator/coordinator/moderator ) drawn from { GPT-5.4-mini , GPT-5.4-nano } \{\texttt{GPT-5.4-mini},\texttt{GPT-5.4-nano}\} , with at most 20 20 LLM calls per workflow execution (§ B ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了覆盖已确立的协调模式并允许多阶段组合，我们为搜索空间配备了六种算子原语 𝒪 \mathcal{O}（图 2、表 VIII；§ C-A），它们综合自近期的多智能体系统综述 [19, 35, 30, 5]：单智能体线性链式（Sequential）、先隔离并行扇出再一次性聚合（Star）、向持久共享文档进行黑板式顺序写入（SharedMemory；13）、全员对等的提案交换（Debate），以及中心辐射式或带主持人的多轮变体（StarWithCoordinator、DebateWithModerator）。 graph.py 中的一个操作是对某一算子原语的异步调用，其参数由优化器选定：n ∈ [ 1 , 10 ] n\in[1,10] 个智能体（worker）、r ∈ [ 1 , 5 ] r\in[1,5] 轮，以及 prompt.py 中的自定义提示词。 一轮是指该算子通信模式的一次完整执行，例如每个 SharedMemory 智能体读取文档一次并追加内容，或每个 Debate 智能体读取其同伴的提案一次并修改；r > 1 r>1 的算子会将此过程重复 r r 次，每次执行都以上一次的结果为条件（图 2 针对 r = 2 r{=}2 绘制）；这些算子轮次不同于上文 MCTS 搜索的 N = 20 N{=}20 轮。 操作可以按顺序或按条件链式组合，前一个算子的输出（以及原始问题）会被转发到下一个算子的提示词中（例如图 3 中的 Star → Sequential \textsc{Star}\to\textsc{Sequential}；最常见的链式组合列于表 XII）。 每个算子最多使用两种 LLM 角色（一个 worker 和一个聚合器/协调者/主持人），从 { GPT-5.4-mini , GPT-5.4-nano } \{\texttt{GPT-5.4-mini},\texttt{GPT-5.4-nano}\} 中选取，每次工作流执行最多进行 20 20 次 LLM 调用（§ B）。

paragraphs.en: All agents operate in a pure-reasoning, tool-free setting (no code interpreters or search tools), so collaboration acts only through task decomposition, diverse candidate generation, peer verification, and shared state tracking. For each bundle T T , we deterministically generate M = 20 M=20 instances and reuse this fixed set across all K = 5 K=5 searches and N = 20 N=20 rounds within that bundle so score differences reflect workflow structure rather than instance sampling noise (§ C-D ). Filtering 1,031 1{,}031 syntax-invalid workflows ( 3.0 % 3.0\% ) and excluding 4 4 sliding-tile puzzles where all single-agent baselines and workflows scored 0.00 0.00 (§ C-E ) yields 28,568 28{,}568 executable workflows across 26 26 puzzles.

paragraphs.en: Automated workflow search and empirical design-space science are complementary: the non-argmax rounds that search discards provide exactly the negative and intermediate comparisons needed to explain why designs fail and which edits help. Full traces also expose accuracy-cost trade-offs: SharedMemory costs more than Debate or Star ($0.25 vs. $0.13; Table XI ) as the shared document grows, yet its persistent written state avoids the information loss of multi-round dialogue and yields the highest mean accuracy in the corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化工作流搜索与实证设计空间科学是互补的：搜索所丢弃的非最优轮次，恰好提供了用于解释设计为何失败以及哪些修改有效的负面与中间比较信息。 完整轨迹还揭示了准确率与成本的权衡：随着共享文档的增长，SharedMemory 的成本高于 Debate 或 Star（0.25 美元对 0.13 美元；表 XI），但其持久化的写入状态避免了多轮对话中的信息丢失，并在语料库中取得了最高的平均准确率。

paragraphs.en: Macro-topology alone ( graph.py ) explains only part of workflow variance ( R 2 = 0.521 R^{2}=0.521 ); jointly mining sub-topological prompt structure ( prompt.py ) lifts out-of-sample predictive power to R 2 = 0.638 R^{2}=0.638 (§ V-B ). Topology benchmarks should therefore report and control for prompt template richness and placeholder routing rather than treating prompts as fixed constants: an ostensibly superior communication graph can be bottlenecked by underspecified role instructions or missing context placeholders.

paragraphs.en: Feeding mined regularities back into the operator registry could guide the synthesis of new operator primitives [ 23 , 8 ] or prune suboptimal entry-point patterns (such as uncoordinated Star -first fan-out) from the optimizer’s search prior, and extending the pipeline to tool-rich domains such as coding [ 16 ] , games [ 11 ] , and social simulations [ 7 ] will test how topological and prompt principles interact with external tool use and environment feedback.

paragraphs.en: We presented an end-to-end pipeline that moves multi-agent LLM workflow design from manual “folk wisdom” toward systematic statistical mining of design principles. Full-trace AFlow search over 26 deterministically verified Enigmata tasks yielded 28,568 28{,}568 executable workflows, and a sandboxed, search-level-split AutoResearch loop over 300 trials surfaced out-of-sample verified principles at three granularities: Star -first fan-out degrades accuracy, blackboard-style SharedMemory outperforms conversational debate, and prompt template specificity and placeholder routing matter as much as macroscopic topology. We release the workflow corpus, evaluation harness, and sandboxed analysis pipeline for reproducible empirical research on multi-agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一个端到端的流水线，将多智能体 LLM 工作流设计从手工式的“民间经验”转向对设计原则的系统性统计挖掘。 在 26 个经确定性验证的 Enigmata 任务上进行的全轨迹 AFlow 搜索生成了 28,568 个可执行工作流，并且在 300 次试验上运行的沙箱化、搜索级切分的 AutoResearch 循环揭示了三个粒度上的样本外验证原则：Star 优先的扇出会降低准确率，黑板式的 SharedMemory 优于对话式辩论，而提示词模板的具体性和占位符路由与宏观拓扑同样重要。 我们发布了工作流语料库、评测框架和沙箱化分析流水线，以支持可复现的多智能体系统实证研究。

paragraphs.en: To isolate multi-agent coordination and prompt structure from external confounds, our experiments focus on tool-free, deterministically verified reasoning tasks from Enigmata and evaluate workflows within a single model family ( GPT-5.4 as the MCTS optimizer and { GPT-5.4-mini , GPT-5.4-nano } as worker and aggregator backbones; § B ). While this controlled setup eliminates grading noise and API variance (Appendix A ), extending our pipeline to open-weight model families, alternative workflow search algorithms, and tool-interactive domains (such as repository-level coding or web navigation) is a natural direction for future work. Finally, because our corpus harvests trajectories generated along MCTS optimization runs, the mined principles reflect structural regularities within the space of executable workflows explored by the optimizer rather than unconstrained random code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将多智能体协作与提示结构同外部干扰因素隔离开来，我们的实验聚焦于来自 Enigmata 的无工具、可确定性验证的推理任务，并在单一模型族内评估工作流（以 GPT-5.4 作为 MCTS 优化器，以 { GPT-5.4-mini , GPT-5.4-nano } 作为智能体与聚合器的骨干模型；§ B ）。 尽管这一受控设置消除了评分噪声与 API 方差（附录 A ），但将我们的流程扩展到开放权重模型族、其他工作流搜索算法以及工具交互领域（例如仓库级编程或网页导航），是未来工作的自然方向。 最后，由于我们的语料库收集的是沿 MCTS 优化过程生成的轨迹，所挖掘的原则反映的是优化器所探索的可执行工作流空间中的结构规律，而非无约束的随机代码生成。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating tool-free workflows on Enigmata [ 3 ] eliminates subjective judge variance ( ϵ judge = 0 \epsilon_{\text{judge}}=0 ) because every puzzle instance is scored by an exact, deterministic rule-based verifier. paragraphs.zh: 在 Enigmata 上评估免工具工作流消除了主观裁判的方差（ϵ judge = 0 \epsilon_{\text{judge}}=0），因为每个谜题实例都由精确、确定性的基于规则的验证器打分。 此外，由于同一组固定的 M = 20 M=20 个确定性生成的实例在同一个 (puzzle, difficulty) 单元内被复用于所有 K = 5 K=5 次搜索和 N = 20 N=20 轮 MCTS（§ C-D），因此在同一单元内比较的各工作流之间的实例采样方差会在逐谜题配对对比 Δ = 𝔼 ⁡ [ score ∣ high arm ] − 𝔼 ⁡ [ score ∣ low arm ] \Delta=\mathbb{E}[\text{score}\mid\text{high arm}]-\mathbb{E}[\text{score}\mid\text{low arm}] 中相互抵消。

paragraphs.en: Each candidate design principle is evaluated per puzzle. For a given feature, workflows are partitioned within each puzzle into a high arm and a low arm : for binary features (e.g., presence of a SharedMemory operator) the high arm consists of workflows where the feature is present and the low arm those where it is absent; for count or continuous features (e.g., mean prompt-template character length) the partition is the per-puzzle median split, with the high arm strictly above the median and the low arm at or below. The per-puzzle effect size is the difference in mean score between the two arms, Δ = 𝔼 ⁡ [ score ∣ high arm ] − 𝔼 ⁡ [ score ∣ low arm ] \Delta=\mathbb{E}[\text{score}\mid\text{high arm}]-\mathbb{E}[\text{score}\mid\text{low arm}] , and per-puzzle verdicts are aggregated to a principle-level verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 每个候选设计原则都按谜题逐一评估。 对于给定特征，在每个谜题内将工作流划分为高组臂和低组臂：对于二元特征（例如，是否存在 SharedMemory 算子），高组臂由具备该特征的工作流组成，低组臂由不具备该特征的工作流组成；对于计数或连续特征（例如，提示词模板的平均字符长度），则按每个谜题的中位数进行划分，高组臂严格高于中位数，低组臂等于或低于中位数。 每个谜题的效应量是两组臂之间的平均得分之差，Δ = 𝔼 ⁡ [ score ∣ high arm ] − 𝔼 ⁡ [ score ∣ low arm ] \Delta=\mathbb{E}[\text{score}\mid\text{high arm}]-\mathbb{E}[\text{score}\mid\text{low arm}]，各谜题的判定再汇总为原则层面的判定。

paragraphs.en: For each puzzle, we fit a LightGBM regressor on the training-split workflows (200 trees, learning rate 0.05, 31 leaves, min_child_samples = 10, fixed seed) predicting score from design features, and evaluate it on the puzzle’s held-out validation workflows. A puzzle is admitted iff validation R 2 > 0.05 R^{2}>0.05 and Spearman ρ > 0.30 \rho>0.30 . Both are required: a constant predictor attains R 2 = 0 R^{2}=0 with undefined ρ \rho , while a rank-preserving but magnitude-compressing predictor attains ρ > 0 \rho>0 with R 2 ≤ 0 R^{2}\leq 0 , so the conjunction enforces both calibration and ranking (see § I ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个谜题，我们在训练集工作流上拟合一个 LightGBM 回归器（200 棵树、学习率 0.05、31 个叶子节点、min_child_samples = 10、固定随机种子），以设计特征预测分数，并在该谜题留出的验证集工作流上进行评估。 当验证集 R 2 > 0.05 R^{2}>0.05 且 Spearman ρ > 0.30 \rho>0.30 时，谜题才被纳入。 两个条件都必不可少：常数预测器得到 R 2 = 0 R^{2}=0 且 ρ \rho 无定义，而保持排序但压缩幅度的预测器得到 ρ > 0 \rho>0 且 R 2 ≤ 0 R^{2}\leq 0，因此二者的合取同时保证了校准和排序（参见 § I）。

sents.en: For each puzzle, we fit a LightGBM regressor on the training-split workflows (200 trees, learning rate 0.05, 31 leaves, min_child_samples = 10, fixed seed) predicting score from design features, and evaluate it on the puzzle’s held-out validation workflows.
sents.zh: 对于每个谜题，我们在训练集工作流上拟合一个 LightGBM 回归器（200 棵树、学习率 0.05、31 个叶子节点、min_child_samples = 10、固定随机种子），以设计特征预测分数，并在该谜题留出的验证集工作流上进行评估。

sents.en: A puzzle is admitted iff validation R 2 > 0.05 R^{2}>0.05 and Spearman ρ > 0.30 \rho>0.30 .
sents.zh: 当验证集 R 2 > 0.05 R^{2}>0.05 且 Spearman ρ > 0.30 \rho>0.30 时，谜题才被纳入。

sents.en: Both are required: a constant predictor attains R 2 = 0 R^{2}=0 with undefined ρ \rho , while a rank-preserving but magnitude-compressing predictor attains ρ > 0 \rho>0 with R 2 ≤ 0 R^{2}\leq 0 , so the conjunction enforces both calibration and ranking (see § I ).
sents.zh: 两个条件都必不可少：常数预测器得到 R 2 = 0 R^{2}=0 且 ρ \rho 无定义，而保持排序但压缩幅度的预测器得到 ρ > 0 \rho>0 且 R 2 ≤ 0 R^{2}\leq 0，因此二者的合取同时保证了校准和排序（参见 § I）。

paragraphs.en: The predictability gate is parameterized by the feature set supplied to the regression surrogate, since the admission of a puzzle is meaningful only if the surrogate has access to features of the type the candidate principle concerns. A puzzle whose validation R 2 R^{2} exceeds the gate threshold under a feature set that includes prompt-length statistics provides no evidence that its score variation is explained by structural design choices; conversely, restricting the surrogate to structural features alone risks excluding puzzles whose design signal is real but weaker than a prompt signal.
paragraphs.zh: 可预测性门控由提供给回归代理模型的特征集参数化，因为只有当代理模型能够访问候选原理所涉及类型的特征时，谜题的准入才有意义。 在包含提示长度统计的特征集下，某个谜题的验证 R 2 R^{2} 超过门控阈值，并不能提供任何证据表明其分数变化是由结构性设计选择所解释的；相反，将代理模型仅限制在结构特征上，可能会排除那些设计信号真实但弱于提示信号的谜题。

paragraphs.en: We designed the operator set based on an extensive literature review covering contemporary research papers [ 35 , 30 , 15 , 5 , 24 ] , agentic system design whitepapers, and guidelines from popular GitHub repositories. paragraphs.en: The operator set is the unit of architectural variation in our search space. Each operator is a multi-agent topology primitive whose call signature exposes a small set of structural knobs (number of agents, number of rounds, prompts) and consumes one or two of the three LLM roles: worker , aggregator (or its role-equivalents coordinator , moderator ), and optimizer . The six operators currently registered are listed below; Fig. 2 draws each of them for n = 3 n=3 workers and r = 2 r=2 rounds together with its call and step counts, and Fig. 3 shows how two operators are chained inside graph.py . All extend a common base class that clamps the multi-agent knobs to safe ranges: 1 ≤ num_agents ≤ 10 1\leq\texttt{num\_agents}\leq 10 and 1 ≤ num_rounds ≤ 5 1\leq\texttt{num\_rounds}\leq 5 , so that any concrete workflow has a bounded LLM-call budget regardless of the optimizer’s choices. A round is one complete pass of the operator’s communication pattern (every worker acts once); operators with num_rounds > 1 \texttt{num\_rounds}>1 repeat this pass, each time conditioned on the state produced by the previous pass. Table VIII summarizes the parameters and call counts of each operator.
paragraphs.zh: 算子集是我们的搜索空间中架构变化的基本单元。 每个算子都是一个多智能体拓扑原语，其调用签名暴露出一小组结构性旋钮（智能体数量、轮数、提示词），并消耗三个 LLM 角色中的一个或两个：worker、aggregator（或其角色等价物 coordinator、moderator）以及 optimizer。 当前注册的六个算子如下所列；图 2 画出了它们各自在 n=3 个 worker 和 r=2 轮下的情形，并附上其调用次数和步数，图 3 展示了两个算子在 graph.py 中是如何被串联起来的。 所有算子都继承自一个共同的基类，该基类将多智能体旋钮限制在安全范围内：1 ≤ num_agents ≤ 10 以及 1 ≤ num_rounds ≤ 5，从而无论 optimizer 做出何种选择，任何具体的工作流都具有有界的 LLM 调用预算。 一轮是指算子通信模式的一次完整遍历（每个 worker 行动一次）；num_rounds > 1 的算子会重复这一遍历，每次都以上一次遍历产生的状态为条件。 表 VIII 总结了每个算子的参数和调用次数。

paragraphs.en: A pipeline of single-agent calls. paragraphs.en: The AFlow codebase [ 33 ] was modified along three axes. First, the operator registry was replaced with the six primitives of § C-A , with corresponding updates to the optimizer-facing operator manual injected into the modification prompt (§ D-D ). Second, the dataset adapter was extended to interface with the Enigmata generators and verifiers; this required matching Enigmata’s per-puzzle scoring contracts to AFlow’s evaluator interface and routing the difficulty-bundle parameter through the existing task-config plumbing. Third, the per-round telemetry was extended to record 1) per-call worker/aggregator role attribution, and 2) the prompts emitted by the optimizer for each instantiation.
paragraphs.zh: 对 AFlow 代码库 [ 33 ] 沿三个方向进行了修改。 首先，将算子注册表替换为 § C-A 中的六个原语，并对注入修改提示（§ D-D ）中面向优化器的算子手册进行了相应更新。 其次，扩展了数据集适配器以对接 Enigmata 的生成器与验证器；这需要将 Enigmata 的逐谜题评分约定与 AFlow 的评估器接口相匹配，并将难度包参数接入现有的任务配置通道。 第三，扩展了每轮遥测记录，以记录 1) 每次调用的工作者/聚合器角色归属，以及 2) 优化器为每次实例化生成的提示。

paragraphs.en: Of the 30 30 retained puzzles, four (EightPuzzle, NinePuzzle, FifteenPuzzle, and SixteenPuzzle), all in the Sequential category, were excluded from the analysis corpus. On these puzzles, the maximum score across the entire set was 0 0 : no workflow ever produced a verifier-accepted solution at any difficulty level. Inspection of representative completions confirmed that the failure mode is uniform across operators and difficulty bundles, with the worker model either emitting an incorrect move sequence or asserting that no solution exists. Because admission to the predictability gate requires non-degenerate score variance within a puzzle, these four puzzles cannot contribute to any per-puzzle effect-size estimate; retaining them would inflate n total n_{\mathrm{total}} without adding statistical power. The filtered analysis corpus therefore comprises 26 26 puzzles and 28,568 28{,}568 workflows (Table IX ).

paragraphs.en: The three-way split is assigned at the level of the AFlow search , not the workflow. Each search is identified by a stable hash of its full configuration; the assignment is deterministic per hash with a fixed seed (so a re-run on the same configuration lands in the same split), and the corpus-flattening step only inherits this assignment without resampling. After flattening, every workflow lives at a content-free identifier workflow_id = sha1 ( search_hash : round ) [ : 16 ] \texttt{workflow\_id}=\text{sha1}(\texttt{search\_hash}\!:\!\texttt{round})[:16] ; the legacy (task, round, search_hash) path components are removed from the directory structure, and the two task-/round-dependent imports inside each workflow’s graph source are rewritten to neutral, content-free forms. Together, these guarantee that the workflow source is independent of its on-disk path. The reproducibility contract on the loop is stronger than just split determinism: on any commit, re-running the analysis script after the flattening step must reproduce the committed findings snapshot and the structured metrics record byte-for-byte. This is enforced through pinned random seeds inside every random-state-bearing step of the regression pipeline, a frozen dependency environment, and a prohibition on machine-local state beyond the workflow corpus and a single targets cache.

sents.zh: 扁平化之后，每个工作流都位于一个无内容的标识符 workflow_id = sha1(search_hash:round)[:16] \texttt{workflow\_id}=\text{sha1}(\texttt{search\_hash}\!:\!\texttt{round})[:16] 之下；遗留的 (task, round, search_hash) 路径组件从目录结构中移除，并且每个工作流图源码内部的两处依赖任务/轮次的导入被改写为中立、无内容的形式。

sents.en: Together, these guarantee that the workflow source is independent of its on-disk path.
sents.zh: 这些措施共同保证了工作流源码独立于其在磁盘上的路径。

sents.en: The reproducibility contract on the loop is stronger than just split determinism: on any commit, re-running the analysis script after the flattening step must reproduce the committed findings snapshot and the structured metrics record byte-for-byte.
sents.zh: 该循环上的可复现性契约比单纯的划分确定性更强：在任意提交上，在扁平化步骤之后重新运行分析脚本必须逐字节复现已提交的发现快照和结构化指标记录。

sents.en: This is enforced through pinned random seeds inside every random-state-bearing step of the regression pipeline, a frozen dependency environment, and a prohibition on machine-local state beyond the workflow corpus and a single targets cache.
sents.zh: 这是通过在回归流水线中每个含随机状态的步骤内固定随机种子、冻结依赖环境，以及禁止在除工作流语料库和单一 targets 缓存之外使用机器本地状态来强制实现的。

paragraphs.en: The row-level identifiers ( workflow_id , round index, configuration hash) are forbidden as features, including in any reconstructed or hashed form. The split column itself is also forbidden.
paragraphs.zh: 行级标识符（workflow_id、轮次索引、配置哈希）被禁止作为特征使用，包括任何重构或哈希后的形式。 分割列本身同样被禁止使用。

paragraphs.en: No feature may depend on the primary target m m or on the workflow’s total cost on any row. This prohibition extends to target encoding of categoricals (smoothed or otherwise), per-group target aggregates, residuals, ranks, and label-derived difficulty priors. A label-derived feature is, by construction, never a property of the workflow’s design.
paragraphs.zh: 任何特征都不得依赖于主目标 m m，也不得依赖于工作流在任意一行上的总成本。 这项禁令同样适用于类别的目标编码（平滑或其他方式）、按组的目标聚合、残差、排名，以及由标签衍生的难度先验。 由标签衍生的特征，就其构造而言，永远不是工作流设计本身的属性。

paragraphs.en: Every iteration of the autonomous loop atomically commits, alongside the analysis script, a fixed set of artifacts that together render any past iteration replayable from the git history alone:
paragraphs.zh: 自主循环的每次迭代都会与分析脚本一起，原子性地提交一组固定的产物，这些产物共同使得任何历史迭代都可以仅凭 git 历史进行重放：

paragraphs.en: metrics.json : structured metrics, feature names, and top coefficients (the time-series source for Fig. 7 );
paragraphs.zh: metrics.json：结构化指标、特征名称及主要系数（图 7 的时间序列数据来源）；

paragraphs.en: feature_names.json : the active feature list as a flat array;
paragraphs.zh: feature_names.json：以扁平数组形式表示的当前生效的特征列表；

paragraphs.en: train.py : the training script driving feature engineering and surrogate fitting.
paragraphs.zh: train.py：驱动特征工程与代理模型拟合的训练脚本。

paragraphs.en: The fitted model and preprocessor binaries are written outside the git tree and overwritten on each run; checking out a past commit and re-running the analysis script regenerates them, and serves as the byte-for-byte reproducibility check.
paragraphs.zh: 拟合的模型和预处理器二进制文件被写入 git 树之外，并在每次运行时被覆盖；检出任一历史提交并重新运行分析脚本即可重新生成它们，这也起到了逐字节可复现性验证的作用。

paragraphs.en: A per-commit log table accompanies the artifacts and functions as the running lab notebook of the autonomous loop. Every attempt, whether accepted, discarded, or aborted by a runtime error, appears in this log because the branch is append-only by construction. The verdict labels are the agent’s own classification, recorded at the time of commit; they are included as a reproducibility artifact rather than a primary result, and are not used as features by the surrogate.
paragraphs.zh: 一张按提交记录的日志表伴随这些产物，充当自主循环的运行实验记录本。 每一次尝试，无论是被接受、被丢弃，还是因运行时错误而中止，都会出现在该日志中，因为该分支在构造上是仅追加的。 判定标签是智能体在提交时所做分类的自身记录；它们作为可复现性产物而非主要结果被包含在内，并且不会被代理模型用作特征。

paragraphs.en: The combination of an LLM-driven feature proposer and a sandboxed evaluation loop is, by construction, susceptible to feature constructions that exploit incidental dataset structure rather than workflow design. Two failure modes were observed during early AutoResearch runs and addressed before the design principles reported were finalized.

paragraphs.en: An early proposal used the AFlow round index as a direct numerical feature, exploiting the fact that later-round workflows tend to be selected from higher-scoring parents and therefore inherit a positive score correlation that is unrelated to architectural design. The mitigation strips the round index from the feature-side metadata exposed to the feature-mining loop and restricts the available artifacts to the Python implementations of the workflows. The round index is retained in evaluation metadata for analysis bookkeeping but is never visible to ϕ \phi .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的一项提案将 AFlow 的轮次索引作为直接的数值特征，利用了这样一个事实：后轮次的工作流往往是从得分更高的父代中选出的，因此会继承一种与架构设计无关的正向得分相关性。 缓解措施将轮次索引从暴露给特征挖掘循环的特征侧元数据中移除，并将可用工件限制为工作流的 Python 实现。 轮次索引保留在用于分析记录的评估元数据中，但对 ϕ \phi 永远不可见。

paragraphs.en: We provide LLM-MAS adapted parts of the prompts used by AFlow to conduct the workflow searches, tailored to our operator set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供了由 AFlow 使用并经适配用于 LLM-MAS 的部分提示词，以进行工作流搜索，并针对我们的算子集进行了调整。

paragraphs.en: The per-cell confidence intervals reported in § V-B and in Tables V – VII are computed using cluster-Wald standard errors with the AFlow search identifier as the clustering unit. Clustering at the search level rather than at the workflow level is the appropriate choice: workflows generated within the same MCTS trace are not independent draws from the workflow population, since the optimizer conditions each expansion on the score history of its parent. The cluster-Wald estimator is consistent in the large-cluster-count limit, with standard recommendations requiring at least G ≥ 15 G\geq 15 clusters per arm for nominal coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 第 V-B 节及表 V–VII 中报告的每个单元（per-cell）置信区间均采用聚类-沃尔德（cluster-Wald）标准误计算，并以 AFlow 搜索标识符作为聚类单位。 以搜索层级而非工作流层级进行聚类是恰当的选择：同一条 MCTS 轨迹内生成的工作流并非从工作流总体中独立抽取，因为优化器在每次扩展时都以其父节点的得分历史为条件。 聚类-沃尔德估计量在聚类数目较大的极限下是一致的，标准建议要求每个实验组至少有 G ≥ 15 个聚类才能获得名义覆盖率。

paragraphs.en: The held-out test split is, by construction, more sparsely supported at the cluster level: the search-level split assigns each AFlow search to exactly one of train, validation, and test, and the test split contains ∼ 15 % \sim 15\% of searches. paragraphs.en: We explored various styles of prompts and constraints for the AutoResearch loop to mitigate overfitting, leading to different exploration trajectories and saving protocols; we narrowed our focus to 300 300 feature-engineering trials spread across 10 10 main AutoResearch searches. We used features from these different search traces to generate 70 70 candidate binarized feature contrasts (spanning the three granularities in Table XV ), covering hypotheses related to prompt information, number of rounds and agents in workflows, operator positions, and derived features combining merging features.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探索了用于 AutoResearch 循环的多种提示词与约束风格以缓解过拟合，由此得到了不同的探索轨迹和保存协议；我们将焦点收窄为 300 300 次特征工程试验，分布在 10 10 次主要的 AutoResearch 搜索中。 我们利用这些不同搜索轨迹中的特征生成了 70 70 个候选二值化特征对比（涵盖表 XV 中的三种粒度），其假设涉及提示词信息、工作流中的轮数与智能体数量、算子位置，以及结合合并特征得到的派生特征。

paragraphs.en: For instance the two search traces from Fig. 7 cover two setups, one with access to both graph.py (containing the executable workflow code) and prompt.py (custom generated prompts), and the other with access only to graph.py . The search with access to prompt data ran for 49 49 trials, 46.9 % 46.9\% of which were accepted and grew the feature set from 12 to 32. The search with access only to graph.py started with an initial set of 12 features and decreased it to 9 features over 90 trials. Not all trials necessarily optimize features, as the automated search sometimes attempts to optimize model hyperparameters or change the model class directly.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，图 7 中的两条搜索轨迹涵盖了两种设置：一种可以访问 graph.py（包含可执行的工作流代码）和 prompt.py（自定义生成的提示词），另一种只能访问 graph.py。 可以访问提示词数据的搜索运行了 49 次试验，其中 46.9% 的试验被接受，并将特征集从 12 个扩展到 32 个。 只能访问 graph.py 的搜索从 12 个特征的初始集合开始，在 90 次试验中将其减少到 9 个特征。 并非所有试验都必然在优化特征，因为自动化搜索有时会尝试优化模型超参数或直接更改模型类别。

paragraphs.en: The validation thresholds R 2 > 0.05 R^{2}>0.05 and Spearman ρ > 0.30 \rho>0.30 used in the predictability gate (§ V-B ) were chosen to lie a non-trivial margin above the performance attainable by chance under the same fitting procedure. To estimate this chance baseline, we construct a permutation null distribution: for each puzzle, the training-split score column was shuffled ten times, the LightGBM regressor was refit on each permuted training set, and the resulting model was evaluated on the unshuffled validation rows. This procedure preserves the marginal distribution of design features and the validation targets, while severing the feature–score association that the regressor is intended to capture; the resulting ( R 2 , ρ ) (R^{2},\rho) pairs therefore characterize the signal that the fitting procedure attributes to noise alone.
paragraphs.zh: 预测性门槛（§ V-B）中使用的验证阈值 R² > 0.05 与 Spearman ρ > 0.30，被选定在相同拟合程序下随机所能达到的性能之上留有非微小的余量。 为估计这一随机基线，我们构造了置换零分布：对每个谜题，将训练集的分数列打乱十次，在每次打乱后的训练集上重新拟合 LightGBM 回归器，并在未打乱的验证行上评估所得模型。 该过程保留了设计特征与验证目标的边际分布，同时切断了回归器所要捕捉的特征—分数关联；因此所得的 (R², ρ) 对刻画了拟合程序单独归因于噪声的信号。

paragraphs.en: The 95th percentile of the pooled null distribution, computed across all puzzles and across every feature-set variant considered during the AutoResearch iteration loop, satisfies R p ​ 95 2 ≤ − 0.06 R^{2}_{p95}\leq-0.06 and ρ p ​ 95 ≤ 0.23 \rho_{p95}\leq 0.23 (visualized per puzzle in Fig. 12 ). The admission thresholds therefore exceed the worst-case null upper tail by at least 0.07 0.07 on ρ \rho and at least 0.11 0.11 on R 2 R^{2} , so any admitted puzzle clears chance by a non-trivial and feature-set-invariant margin. The choice is conservative in the sense that it prioritizes false-negative robustness, admitting fewer puzzles in exchange for stronger guarantees on those that are admitted, which is appropriate for a downstream aggregation step in which a single floor or zero-variance puzzle would otherwise dilute the across-puzzle contrast.

paragraphs.en: The contribution of this work is methodological rather than capability-oriented: our framework does not introduce a new agent or extend the capability frontier of any deployed system, but provides a methodology under which the determinants of agentic performance can be examined statistically. The design principles surfaced by our analysis, although not directly deployable, contribute incrementally to the general advance of agentic capability and inherit the dual-use risk common to capability research.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作的贡献是方法论层面的，而非能力导向的：我们的框架并未引入新的智能体，也未扩展任何已部署系统的能力边界，而是提供了一种方法论，使智能体性能的决定因素能够得到统计学上的考察。 我们的分析所揭示的设计原则虽然不能直接部署，但对智能体能力的总体进步有增量贡献，并继承了能力研究普遍存在的双用途风险。
